explicitSession: A real CLI process inherits an existing foreign CODEX_THREAD_ID binding, selects the explicit session ID, returns no binding, and preserves two sessions and one host binding
explicitHostBinding: Explicit host/thread with a conflicting session keeps the binding conflict and preserves saved rows
environmentConvenience: Omitting session and host/thread resolves the existing environment binding
hostIndependentEntry: Omitting host/thread and environment returns the plain project URL without creating a scope or binding
emptySession: Empty and whitespace session values fail before service startup; the isolated empty project retains no runtime or data directory
fixtures: New temporary projects and ephemeral localhost services; binding counts read through the fixture service's database handle
